name: web-orlina-interaction-concept-and-ux-principles-cards
title: Orlina interaction concept cards (hover, scroll, micro-interaction) and UX principles on a timeline
whatItIs: A dark page with a blue floral silk ribbon for 'Interaction Concept 06' and three notched cards (Hover: image zoom, card lift; Scroll: smooth reveal; Micro Interaction: add to cart, wishlist), then a green silk ribbon for 'UX Principles 07' with icons for Discoverability, Visual Hierarchy, Consistency, Minimal Friction and Visual Confidence on horizontal lines.
whatItMeans: Thoughtful and premium; even abstract principles get tactile fabric and tidy icon cards.
techniques: List interaction behaviours in three icon cards.
Change the ribbon fabric colour per chapter.
Lay principles along staggered horizontal rules.

vocabulary.definition: A small animated response to one action.
How an element looks when the cursor is over it.
